vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2026-0235
vulnerability.description: rkyv: insufficient archive validation can cause out-of-bounds reads in archives containing Rc/Arc

statements.impact_statement: rkyv 0.7 appears in Cargo.lock only as an optional dependency of rust_decimal whose feature this workspace never enables. `cargo tree -i rkyv` prints 'nothing to print': no crate depends on it and it is never compiled into any artifact. The lockfile records optional dependencies regardless. Re-check if rust_decimal's `rkyv` feature is ever turned on.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm
vulnerability.description: braces: stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested brace patterns

statements.impact_statement: braces is in site/pnpm-lock.yaml only, the docs site's build tooling, through micromatch 4.0.8, which only starlight-llms-txt 0.11.0 depends on (its generator.ts matches page ids against the include, exclude, promote and demote patterns). Those patterns are the ones site/astro.config.ts sets, so the nested patterns the advisory needs would have to be committed to this repository, and the worst they do is crash a docs build. Nothing in site/ ships in a crate, wheel or npm package. Re-check if the site starts taking glob patterns from anything other than its own config, or when braces publishes a fixed release.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp
vulnerability.description: http-cache-semantics: max-stale handling can disclose cross-user cached responses

statements.impact_statement: http-cache-semantics is in site/pnpm-lock.yaml only, through astro 7.2.9, which imports it in dist/assets/build/remote.js to cache remote images it fetches during a build. The advisory needs a shared cache that answers requests from several users, one of them sending a large max-stale. The site builds static files (site/astro.config.ts sets no output mode and no adapter, and uses passthroughImageService), so no server runs this code, and the only requests it sees are the ones the build itself makes. Re-check if the site gains a server adapter or on-demand rendering, or when http-cache-semantics publishes a fixed release.
